name: Concurrent Grading Race Condition & Non-Idempotent Mutation
description: A PR introduces an async grading worker that increments totalSubmissions and mutates evaluation scores with updateDoc outside runTransaction.
inputDiff: export async function handleGradingTask(submissionId: string) { const doc = await db.collection('submissions').doc(submissionId).get(); const total = doc.data().totalSubmissions; await db.collection('submissions').doc(submissionId).update({ totalSubmissions: total + 1, status: 'graded' }); }

name: Requirement Ambiguity: Exam Submission Cutoff Timezone
description: User story states 'Students must submit before 23:59 on Sunday' but fails to define timezone or handling of network upload latency.
inputSpec: As a professor, I want an automatic cutoff so that students must submit before 23:59 on Sunday. Any attempt after that time should be rejected immediately.

name: Destructive Database Schema Migration Without Backward Compatibility
description: Release candidate drops support for legacy field studentName in favor of studentProfileId without migration fallback.
inputScope: Release v1.2.0: Refactored Firestore database schema. Renamed studentName field to studentProfileId across all collections. Cleaned up legacy fields.

name: Future Autopsy Premortem on Unmonitored Async Grading Spike
description: Sprint planning introduces bulk exam evaluations for university finals week with 500 concurrent students.
inputBacklog: Sprint 14: Enable batch grading for final exams. When exam period closes, trigger simultaneous AI evaluations for all 500 enrolled students.
